My dispatching routine mandates the reviewer_id string "reviewer-cloud-routine-buildcraft". proof/35.json's `author` is "conductor-track-a-buildcraft-01PDRLaG51Uor9D8wTtnpJ25-2026-09-19". Both legitimately embed the repository's own name.

=== FINDING 4 (CONFIRMED, PRE-EXISTING in main, NOT charged to this PR) ===
Same as on #29, #30 and #32: in `lwb_lanes._review_ok` the verdict test runs BEFORE the staleness test and APPENDS to `errors`, so a superseded DISAGREE blocks lwb-lanes forever while a superseded AGREE is correctly skipped as stale. This record will therefore keep failing the gate after its findings are fixed, unless it is superseded at the same path by its own author (which only I can do) or lwb_lanes.py is fixed. Combined with finding 3, the honest summary is: this branch's lane gate cannot be cleared by this reviewer routine at all, in either direction, and that is a property of the gate rather than of the work.
